---
title: "Decision Tree"
output: html_document
---

# Load data
```{r}
library(C50)
library(caret)

madness_train <- readRDS("training_data.rds")
madness_test <- readRDS("testing_data.rds")

# C5.0 needs a factor outcome
madness_train$winner <- as.factor(madness_train$winner)
madness_test$winner <- as.factor(madness_test$winner)
```

# Basic decision tree
```{r}
tree_model <- C5.0(winner ~ ., data = madness_train)

tree_pred <- predict(tree_model, madness_test)

tree_confusion <- confusionMatrix(tree_pred, madness_test$winner, positive = "1")
tree_confusion
```

# Which variables does the tree use?
```{r}
C5imp(tree_model)
```

# Improving the model: boosting
```{r}
boost_model <- C5.0(winner ~ ., data = madness_train, trials = 10)

boost_pred <- predict(boost_model, madness_test)

boost_confusion <- confusionMatrix(boost_pred, madness_test$winner, positive = "1")
boost_confusion
```

# Comparison
```{r}
tree_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Decision tree", "Boosted tree (10 trials)"),
  Accuracy = c(tree_confusion$overall["Accuracy"],
               boost_confusion$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Sensitivity = c(tree_confusion$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                  boost_confusion$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity = c(tree_confusion$byClass["Specificity"],
                  boost_confusion$byClass["Specificity"]),
  Kappa = c(tree_confusion$overall["Kappa"],
            boost_confusion$overall["Kappa"])
)
row.names(tree_comparison) <- NULL
tree_comparison
```

# Saving relevant data files
```{r}
saveRDS(boost_pred, "tree_predictions.rds")
saveRDS(boost_confusion, "tree_confusion_matrix.rds")
```
